description: Pre-declared validation analysis for the baseline. Fixed before inspecting per-class or pair results; not changed in response to them.

bootstrap.method: class-stratified percentile bootstrap: within each true intent, resample that intent's validation indices with replacement at its original count; recompute accuracy and macro-F1 on every replicate

length_bins.source: training-only EDA character-length quartiles (p25 = 36, median = 47, p75 = 64)
length_bins.measure: len() of the original unmodified text
